cases.input: Three test runs raise and reproduce one defect.
cases.expect: One defect identity references all executions; each result keeps its own state.

cases.input: A retry on the unchanged defective build passes once.
cases.expect: Defect cannot be verified fixed because the subject digest did not change.

cases.input: An independent verifier passes tests on a later release digest.
cases.expect: A verification assertion may advance the defect toward closure.

cases.input: The expected result was wrong while product behavior conforms.
cases.expect: Correct the test specification; do not create or close a product defect by implication.

cases.input: Service is restored by rollback while the software fault remains.
cases.expect: Incident may close; defect remains open with remediation references.

cases.input: Two trackers report the same deviation.
cases.expect: Both identifiers remain resolvable and one is marked duplicate of the canonical defect.

cases.input: Authority accepts a non-fix disposition with rationale.
cases.expect: Resolution is retained with justification; it is not represented as verified fixed.
